name: Tanza
description: Tanza is a young deer human/human hybrid girl who serves as the devoted personal attendant to Yorna Mishigure at the Crimson Lapis Castle in Chaosflame. After losing her parents and older sister Zoey, she found a home and purpose under Yorna's care. During Arc 7 and Arc 8, she played a significant supporting role fighting alongside Natsuki Subaru's Pleiades Battalion to defend Chaosflame and the Empire.
